values.AssociatedLNGNotes: Northeast Gateway LNG Terminal is an offshore import port in Massachusetts Bay. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from the time of the port license says the port will deliver up to 800 MMcf/d through a 16-mile subsea pipeline that feeds into Algonquin's existing HubLine. This ties the HubLine to an import terminal. No source ties the line to LNG exports, so the export flag stays blank.

verifications.note: Names the HubLine and says the Northeast Gateway port delivers gas through a 16-mile subsea line feeding it. The page is an older trade article from the port license period.

records.researcher_notes: Import-terminal tie only, so the export flag is blank. The HubLine is not described as built for this terminal, only as the line that takes its gas. Neptune LNG was permitted as a competing offshore port, but I found no source that it was built, so it is not tagged. On 17 November 2026 the flag column changed from yes or blank to export or import, and this line is marked import.
